name: io.github.hunyu-feng/dsh-vision
title: DSH Vision (local Ollama first, Volcano Ark fallback)
description: analyze_image for agents: local Ollama vision by default, Volcano Ark Doubao as fallback.

environmentVariables.name: VISION_MODELS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated chain like `ollama:qwen2.5vl:3b,ark:doubao-seed-2-0-pro-260215`. Defaults to the local model then Ark.

environmentVariables.name: VISION_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Provider used for bare model ids and by default: ollama, ark or openai. Defaults to ollama.

environmentVariables.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Local Ollama OpenAI-compatible base URL. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1.

environmentVariables.name: VOLCANO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Volcano Ark API key; only needed when an `ark:` model is in the chain.

environmentVariables.name: ARK_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Volcano Ark base URL. Defaults to https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3.

environmentVariables.name: DSH_VISION_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory holding the optional config.json settings file. Defaults to ~/.dsh-vision.
